description: Source code for Kubernetes admission plugin 'OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement' implementing permission checks for owner references during resource creation and updates.

classes.name: gcPermissionsEnforcement
classes.description: Implements admission.ValidationInterface to enforce owner reference permission rules.

classes.name: whiteListItem
classes.description: Represents an entry in the whitelist of resources/subresources ignored by permission enforcement.

methods.name: isWhiteListed
methods.description: Checks if a resource/subresource is in the whitelist.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation to enforce owner reference permission rules during admission.

methods.name: SetAuthorizer
methods.description: Sets the authorizer used for permission checks.

methods.name: SetRESTMapper
methods.description: Sets the RESTMapper used for resource mappings.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized with required components.

methods.name: ownerRefToDeleteAttributeRecords
methods.description: Converts an owner reference to a list of delete attribute records for permission checks.

methods.name: blockingOwnerRefs
methods.description: Filters owner references that have BlockOwnerDeletion set to true.

methods.name: indexByUID
methods.description: Indexes owner references by UID for quick lookup.

methods.name: newBlockingOwnerDeletionRefs
methods.description: Determines new blocking owner references and those whose blockOwnerDeletion changed to true.
